items.title: Mary Collins Interview, 1974-09-29
items.q: I was talking to the other night, Mr. Joe Merez, and he was saying about Lee

ctx.x: What I'm saying, did he gauge success by his own personal musical?

He did. He did it. He gained it by his own. Mm-hmm. That's the only way he would ever gotten it because he was a tremendous trumpet player. Tremendous. He had a volume, but he never had to use a mic. Oh, yeah. He'd blow you away if you stood in front of him. And it takes, uh, his friend, uh, I was talking to the other night, Mr. Joe Merez, and he was saying about Lee, he said, my goodness, see that guy stand up. You better get the mic away. You better get the mic away. And that's just the way he blew. Yeah.…
So your, your, your, your fondest memories are your days with Lee. Right. Those last. Still missing. Yeah.
